title: Understand why the product changed without preserving obsolete state
statement: As a reviewer, I can see why the product moved from an earlier state to the current one, so that I can evaluate decisions without the living documentation preserving obsolete alternatives.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Comparison mode pairs a removed explanation with its replacement when their traceability matches.
An ambiguous replacement is paired only when the author explicitly links it.
Comparison mode shows a commit's reason beside the documentation or code it changed.
A documentation record shows when it was introduced.
A documentation record shows what it replaced.
A reader can open the comparison that introduced a documentation record.
After a squash merge, the review history retains the branch's individual commit reasons.
